title: A swap-adversarial framework for domain generalization in pre- and post-stimulation Parkinsonian state classification
abstract: arXiv:2602.10528v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose a novel swap-adversarial framework that mitigates high inter-subject variability and the high-dimensional low-sample-size problem in electrocorticography (ECoG) data. It achieves robust domain generalization across ECoG and electroencephalography (EEG)-based brain-computer interface datasets. Our framework integrates (1) robust preprocessing, (2) inter-subject balanced channel swap (ISBCS) for cross-subject augmentation, and (3) domain-adversarial learning (DAL) to suppress subject-specific bias. The ISBCS method is a bio-inspired channel swapping strategy that exchanges only functionally corresponding channels across subjects, guided by a brain map, to mitigate inter-subject distribution differences. The DAL strategy encourages the model to learn task-relevant shared features. In addition, we introduce a new ECoG dataset, the first reproducible benchmark, which is constructed from long-term ECoG recordings of 6-hydr

translated_title: 一种用于帕金森病刺激前后状态分类领域泛化的交换对抗框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种新颖的交换对抗框架，用于缓解皮质脑电图数据中高度的受试者间变异性和高维小样本问题。该框架在基于ECoG和脑电图（EEG）的脑机接口数据集上实现了稳健的领域泛化。我们的框架集成了三个部分：（1）稳健的预处理，（2）用于跨受试者数据增强的受试者间平衡通道交换（ISBCS），以及（3）用于抑制受试者特异性偏差的领域对抗学习（DAL）。ISBCS方法是一种受生物启发的通道交换策略，在脑图谱的引导下仅交换受试者之间功能对应的通道，从而缓解受试者间的分布差异。DAL策略促使模型学习与任务相关的共享特征。此外，我们引入了一个新的ECoG数据集，这是首个可复现的基准数据集，该数据集由6-羟基多巴胺（6-hydroxydopamine）……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种交换对抗框架，通过受试者间平衡通道交换（ISBCS）与领域对抗学习（DAL）相结合，缓解ECoG数据中受试者间变异性和高维小样本问题，实现帕金森病刺激前后状态分类的跨数据集稳健领域泛化，并发布了首个可复现的ECoG基准数据集。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel swap-adversarial framework that combines inter-subject balanced channel swap (ISBCS) and domain-adversarial learning (DAL) to mitigate inter-subject variability and the high-dimensional low-sample-size problem in ECoG data, achieving robust domain generalization for pre- and post-stimulation Parkinsonian state classification, along with the first reproducible ECoG benchmark dataset.
